info.name: FDIC Bank Data API (Beta) Demographics Structure API

params.name: api_key
params.description: Api key used for api.fdic.gov

params.name: filters
params.description:
The filter for the bank search. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.
Examples:
* Filter by State name  
`STNAME:"West Virginia"`    
* Filter for any one of multiple State names  
`STNAME:("West Virginia","Delaware")`
* Filter all but a specified value  
`!(STNAME:"Virginia")`  
* Filter by last updated within an inclusive date range  
`DATEUPDT:["2010-01-01" TO "2010-12-31"]`
* Filter for deposits over 50,000,000 (50000 thousands of dollars)  
`DEP:[50000 TO *]`

params.name: search
params.description:
Flexible text search against institution records - currently only supporting name search. 
Search supports text search and fuzzy matching, as opposed to filters that are exact matches. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.
Examples:
* Search by name
`NAME: Island`
* Search by name (fuzzy match)
`NAME: Iland`

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma delimited list of fields to search. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field name by which to sort returned data. All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Indicator if ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC). All values must be entered in UPPERCASE.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records to return. Default is 10 and maximum is 10,000.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of page to return.

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the data to return.

params.name: download
params.description: Whether the data should be downloaded as a file.

params.name: filename
params.description: The filename to use when downloading data.
